text: {"label": "Data Recording Tools and Media","definition": "Work on the physical and electronic means of recording behavior and session data, such as cumulative recorders, paper-and-pen versus electronic data collection, tape, and computer interfaces for recording equipment.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Focuses on the recording media and devices themselves, not the accuracy of interval or time-sampling methods, custom circuitry for operant chambers, or ratio-schedule performance."}
